verdict: Meta has been dark since August 6th; volume stopped, fix is in motion.
narrative: Your Meta ads went to zero spend on August 6th and have not run since — all 71 leads this period came from Meta, so the channel going dark means new lead flow has fully paused. The most likely cause is budget exhaustion on your primary campaign, which carried the majority of the 28-day spend on its own. When the ads were running, cost per lead was actually improving, so the issue is continuity, not how the money was performing. Campaigns are being reviewed and restarted this week, and organic presence through Google Business Profile remains healthy and steady in the meantime. Once Meta resumes, you should see lead volume return to prior levels within the first few active days.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta before it went dark on August 6th
cost per lead — efficiency was holding and improving while the ads ran
Google Business Profile actions (calls and website clicks) this period, up slightly week over week

watch_item.issue: 71 leads this period are not showing up as active pipeline opportunities — there is a gap between leads arriving and intake being recorded.
watch_item.fix: The intake process is being audited this week to close that gap and ensure leads move into the pipeline as they come in.
